options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: auto_witness_upgrade
options.description: Whether VxRail will automatically upgrade the witness node

options.name: ip
options.description: IP address of the new node to be added

options.name: profile
options.description: The profile name. Allowed only PRE_UPGRADE, PROACTIVE_HEALTH or NODE_EXPANSION.

options.name: root_password
options.description: Root passwrod of the new node to be added

options.name: root_user
options.description: Root user of the new node to be added

options.name: sn
options.description: Serial number of the new node to be added

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for performing a system precheck, the default value is 300 seconds

options.name: vc_root_password
options.description: The password of vCenter root user account

options.name: vc_root_username
options.description: Username of vCenter root user account

options.name: vc_temporary_gateway
options.description: Temporary IP settings for the vCenter upgrade

options.name: vc_temporary_ip
options.description: Temporary IP settings for the vCenter upgrade

options.name: vc_temporary_netmask
options.description: Temporary IP settings for the vCenter upgrade

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: version
options.description: Install version of the new node to be added

options.name: vxm_root_password
options.description: The password of VxRail Manager root user account

options.name: vxm_root_username
options.description: Username of VxRail Manager root user account

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System

options.name: witness_password
options.description: The password information of witness user account for a stretched cluster, including a vSAN 2-node cluster. The witness object only applies to a cluster when vLCM is not enabled.

options.name: witness_username
options.description: The username information of witness user account for a stretched cluster, including a vSAN 2-node cluster. The witness object only applies to a cluster when vLCM is not enabled.
